source: Client report sample (Global Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT) Devices Market, CMI): research definition, scope and company-profile clusters; owner's choices 2026-10-12 (150 companies, 20 browsers, companies named in the sample seeded and checked like every other company); scope widened 2026-10-12 (diversified makers are core)
market_definition: The Global Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT) Devices Market covers devices that apply controlled sub-atmospheric pressure to promote healing of acute and chronic wounds, with their dressings, drapes and canisters: single-use (disposable) NPWT devices and conventional (reusable) NPWT systems, used for diabetic foot ulcers, pressure ulcers, venous leg ulcers, burns, surgical and traumatic wounds in hospitals and clinics, ambulatory surgery centers and home care.
core_scope: A core player develops, manufactures and sells its own NPWT devices (single-use or conventional pump systems, with their NPWT dressings and canisters) under its own brand -- including large wound-care and medical-device companies for which NPWT is one product line among many (e.g. V.A.C., PICO, Avelle, Avance-type systems).
adjacent_segments: General wound-care companies with no NPWT device of their own
Makers of NPWT dressings, foams or canisters only, sold for other companies' pumps
Distributors, rental and home-medical-equipment service companies
Contract manufacturers producing NPWT devices for other brands
General suction / vacuum pump makers without an NPWT wound-therapy product
scope: Manufacturers of negative pressure wound therapy devices: single-use and conventional NPWT systems with their dressings and canisters, for chronic and acute wounds in hospitals, clinics, ambulatory surgery centers and home care. EXCLUDED: distributors, rental and service companies, contract manufacturers, consumables-only makers and general wound-care companies without an NPWT device. A company counts as core when it makes and sells its own such product under its own brand, EVEN IF this is one product line or division of a larger, diversified business (owner's decision 2026-10-12); only distributors, contract manufacturers, consumables-only suppliers and companies without their own product here are adjacent.
